legend: While staring at the night sky, Johnny began looking for collections of stars in the sky that have a flower-like appearance. In particular, a group of at least three stars in the sky is called a florescent constellation if there exists a circle such that the following two conditions hold:
All stars in the constellation lie on the edge of the circle.
The stars in the constellation are equally spaced around the circle.

Since Johnny wants to find all florescent constellations in the night sky, help him to identify the number of such constellations, so he knows when to stop looking! Two constellations are considered distinct if they differ by at least one star.

The night sky can be modeled as a set of n$$$n$$$ stars in a 2D plane numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, with the i$$$i$$$-th star located at the integer coordinates (xi,yi)$$$(x_i, y_i)$$$. No two stars are located in the same position.
input: The first line contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤1000$$$1 \le n \le 1000$$$) — the number of stars in the night sky.

The next n$$$n$$$ lines each contain two integers, with the i$$$i$$$-th line containing xi$$$x_i$$$ and yi$$$y_i$$$ (−109≤xi,yi≤109$$$-10^9 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^9$$$) — the coordinates of the i$$$i$$$-th star in the night sky.
output: Output a single integer, the number of florescent constellations in the night sky.
note: In the first test case, there is one florescent constellation. In particular, stars 2$$$2$$$, 3$$$3$$$, 4$$$4$$$, and 5$$$5$$$ form a florescent constellation, as they all lie on a single circle and are equally spaced around that circle.

legend.ai: 凝视夜空时，Johnny 开始寻找天空中外形类似花朵的星星集合。具体来说，如果存在一个圆，使得以下两个条件成立，则天空中至少包含三颗星星的一组星星被称为花状星座：
星座中的所有星星都位于该圆的圆周上。
星座中的星星在圆周上等间距分布。
Johnny 想要找出夜空中所有发光星座，请帮助他确定这类星座的数量，这样他就知道什么时候该停止寻找了！如果两个星座至少有一颗星不同，则认为它们是不同的。
夜空可以建模为二维平面上的 n$$$n$$$ 颗星星的集合，星星编号为 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$，第 i$$$i$$$ 颗星位于整数坐标 (xi,yi)$$$(x_i, y_i)$$$ 上。任意两颗星的位置都不相同。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤1000$$$1 \le n \le 1000$$$)，表示夜空中的星星数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数；第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含 xi$$$x_i$$$ 和 yi$$$y_i$$$(−109≤xi,yi≤109$$$-10^9 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^9$$$)，表示夜空中第 i$$$i$$$ 颗星的坐标。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示夜空中发光星座的数量。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，有一个花形星座。具体来说，星星 2$$$2$$$、3$$$3$$$、4$$$4$$$ 和 5$$$5$$$ 构成一个花形星座，因为它们都位于同一个圆上，并且在圆周上等距分布。
